name: Israeli Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 tsp za'atar (can substitute ¼ tsp thyme)

steps: Mix cucumber, tomato, onion, and parsley.
Mix oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and za'atar to make dressing.
Pour dressing over vegetables. Correct seasoning to taste.

culture.text: Israeli salad is a chopped salad of finely diced tomato, onion, cucumber, and bell or chili peppers. It has been described as the "most well-known national dish of Israel", and is a standard accompaniment to most Israeli meals. Salads following similar recipes, with different names, are widespread and popular throughout the Eastern Mediterranean.
